description:
Ministry of Ports and Civil Aviation - Order under section 9 
Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka Act . No 34 of 2002  order
reasoning: The gazette content is an order amending a schedule under the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka Act, No. 34 of 2002. It is a statutory instrument issued by a minister to modify a legal/regulatory framework (specifically, the description of land and facilities related to an airport). The core action is a regulatory amendment, placing it squarely within the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name and contains detailed land descriptions, the primary purpose is not to announce a personnel change (Type 2) or a hybrid appointment (Type 3), nor is it a standalone land transaction (Type 4). It is an exercise of regulatory power to update a legal schedule.
